scope: Independent D143 completion-receipt failure supplement at io.open, distinguishing known zero compile completion from a transport timeout
expectations: A receipt write failure after a well-formed zero compile result propagates the original OSError, records FAILED, runs all first terminal postchecks, and stops after 20 exact dispatches without artifact collection.
A receipt write failure after TimeoutExpired cannot replace that original exception or its bytes. COMPILE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN runs local pin/stage checks and stops after 17 exact dispatches.
